decision_rule: Per instance, compare the qualitative verdict (win/tie/loss at 1e-4) between original seeds and shifted seeds (201-216). ROBUST iff >=4/5 instances keep the same verdict AND the C11 tau-sweep ordering (quarter<=tau05<=tau075<full on n=5) is preserved. If verdicts flip, the findings are RNG-sensitive and the paper must report seed-dependence.
hypothesis: The key findings are not RNG artifacts: cross n=12 win, ltri n=5 snap-catastrophe, and the cross n=5 tau-sweep ordering all replicate under a shifted seed stream (201-216).
question: Are the key findings robust to RNG stream?
title: RNG robustness on key cells
